independent_method.calculation: Standalone Python using Fraction for fractional financial/allocation values, with no import or call to the author benchmark or checker. Each of all 40 written parts had independent arithmetic, distribution or branch targets. Log decomposition received a separate numerical identity check; proof validity was read algebraically rather than inferred from a grid.
independent_method.globality: Reviewed exact sum-of-squares certificates, concavity and boundary arguments, both policy-floor branches, endowment-demand corner cases, IC/participation/escrow lower bounds, equilibrium best responses and invariant dynamic intervals. Finite probes supplement these arguments; they do not prove globality.
